mapper.select: SELECT E.idEnvio, E.noGuia, E.costo, E.nombreReceptor, E.apellidoPaternoReceptor, E.apellidoMaternoReceptor, E.calleDestino, E.numeroDestino, E.idCliente, E.idSucursal, E.idConductor, E.idColoniaDestino, E.idEstatusEnvio, C.codigo_postal AS codigoPostal, M.nombre AS ciudad, ES.nombre AS estado, EE.estatus AS estatus, S.nombre AS nombreSucursal, COL.nombre AS nombreConductor, COL.apellidoPaterno AS apellidoPaternoConductor, COL.apellidoMaterno AS apellidoMaternoConductor FROM PacketWorld.envio AS E LEFT JOIN mexico.colonias AS C ON E.idColoniaDestino = C.id LEFT JOIN mexico.municipios AS M ON C.municipio = M.id LEFT JOIN mexico.estados AS ES ON M.estado = ES.id LEFT JOIN PacketWorld.estatusEnvio AS EE ON EE.idEstatusEnvio = E.idEstatusEnvio LEFT JOIN PacketWorld.sucursal AS S ON E.idSucursal = S.idSucursal LEFT JOIN PacketWorld.colaborador AS COL ON E.idConductor = COL.idColaborador WHERE E.activo = 1 ORDER BY E.idEnvio;

SELECT E.idEnvio, E.noGuia, E.costo, E.nombreReceptor, E.apellidoPaternoReceptor, E.apellidoMaternoReceptor, E.calleDestino, E.numeroDestino, E.idConductor, E.idColoniaDestino, C.codigo_postal AS codigoPostal, M.nombre AS ciudad, ES.nombre AS estado, EST.estatus AS estatus, E.idCliente, E.idSucursal, E.idEstatusEnvio FROM PacketWorld.envio AS E INNER JOIN PacketWorld.historialEnvio AS H ON E.idEnvio = H.idEnvio AND H.fechaHora = ( SELECT MAX(H2.fechaHora) FROM PacketWorld.historialEnvio H2 WHERE H2.idEnvio = E.idEnvio ) INNER JOIN PacketWorld.estatusEnvio AS EST ON H.idEstatusEnvio = EST.idEstatusEnvio LEFT JOIN mexico.colonias AS C ON E.idColoniaDestino = C.id LEFT JOIN mexico.municipios AS M ON C.municipio = M.id LEFT JOIN mexico.estados AS ES ON M.estado = ES.id WHERE E.idConductor = #{idConductor} AND E.activo = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PacketWorld.envio ( costo, noGuia, nombreReceptor, apellidoPaternoReceptor, apellidoMaternoReceptor, calleDestino, numeroDestino, idColoniaDestino, idCliente, idSucursal, idConductor ) VALUES ( #{costo}, #{noGuia}, #{nombreReceptor}, #{apellidoPaternoReceptor}, #{apellidoMaternoReceptor}, #{calleDestino}, #{numeroDestino}, #{idColoniaDestino}, #{idCliente}, #{idSucursal}, #{idConductor} )
mapper.select:
SELECT E.idEnvio, E.noGuia, E.costo,
E.nombreReceptor, E.apellidoPaternoReceptor, E.apellidoMaternoReceptor,
E.calleDestino, E.numeroDestino,
E.idCliente, E.idSucursal, E.idConductor, E.idColoniaDestino,
C.codigo_postal AS codigoPostal, M.nombre AS ciudad, ES.nombre AS estado
FROM PacketWorld.envio AS E
LEFT JOIN mexico.colonias AS C ON E.idColoniaDestino = C.id
LEFT JOIN mexico.municipios AS M ON C.municipio = M.id
LEFT JOIN mexico.estados AS ES ON M.estado = ES.id
WHERE E.idEnvio = #{idEnvio} AND E.activo = 1;

SELECT E.idEnvio, E.noGuia, E.costo, E.nombreReceptor, E.apellidoPaternoReceptor, E.apellidoMaternoReceptor, E.calleDestino, E.numeroDestino, E.idCliente, E.idSucursal, E.idConductor, E.idColoniaDestino, C.codigo_postal AS codigoPostal, M.nombre AS ciudad, ES.nombre AS estado, CLI.telefono AS telefono, CLI.correo AS correo, SUC.nombre AS nombreSucursal, EST.estatus AS estatus FROM PacketWorld.envio AS E LEFT JOIN mexico.colonias AS C ON E.idColoniaDestino = C.id LEFT JOIN mexico.municipios AS M ON C.municipio = M.id LEFT JOIN mexico.estados AS ES ON M.estado = ES.id INNER JOIN PacketWorld.cliente AS CLI ON E.idCliente = CLI.idCliente INNER JOIN PacketWorld.sucursal AS SUC ON E.idSucursal = SUC.idSucursal LEFT JOIN PacketWorld.historialEnvio AS H ON E.idEnvio = H.idEnvio AND H.idHistorialEnvio = ( SELECT MAX(H2.idHistorialEnvio) FROM PacketWorld.historialEnvio H2 WHERE H2.idEnvio = E.idEnvio ) LEFT JOIN PacketWorld.estatusEnvio AS EST ON H.idEstatusEnvio = EST.idEstatusEnvio WHERE E.noGuia = #{noGuia} AND E.activo = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE PacketWorld.envio SET costo = #{costo}, nombreReceptor = #{nombreReceptor}, apellidoPaternoReceptor = #{apellidoPaternoReceptor}, apellidoMaternoReceptor = #{apellidoMaternoReceptor}, calleDestino = #{calleDestino}, numeroDestino = #{numeroDestino}, idColoniaDestino = #{idColoniaDestino}, idCliente = #{idCliente}, idSucursal = #{idSucursal}, idConductor = #{idConductor, jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE idEnvio = #{idEnvio};
